name: Scrub Field
description: A numeric chip that increases and decreases by dragging horizontally and accepts typed input; values are displayed with Persian digits.
interactionNotes: Drag on the chip to change the number; outside the range, the chip tilts a little and springs back when you let go. `Shift` gives a coarse jump and `Alt` a fine adjustment. Click the number and type — both Persian and Latin digits are read. `ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown` move one step, `PageUp`/`PageDown` ten steps, and `Home`/`End` to either end of the range; `Escape` cancels mid-drag.

props.name: label
props.description: Label next to the number.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Unit next to the number; leave it empty to have none.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value; pass it to control the value yourself.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum of the range.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum of the range.

props.name: step
props.description: Size of each step; the number of decimal places comes from it too.

props.name: size
props.description: Height, font size, radius and the chip's width.

props.name: sensitivity
props.description: How many pixels of dragging count as one `step`; a lower number means faster.

props.name: rubberReach
props.description: How many percent of the range the spring can reach outside `min`/`max`.

props.name: returnDuration
props.description: Duration of the return into the range after release.

props.name: coarseMultiplier
props.description: `Shift` multiplier — the coarse jump.

props.name: fineMultiplier
props.description: `Alt` multiplier — the fine adjustment.

props.name: showDelta
props.description: The floating delta chip above the indicator.

props.name: showDirty
props.description: A ring around the chip when the value differs from `defaultValue`.

props.name: showFill
props.description: The colored fill that shows the size of the value.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color — the value fill, the delta chip and the changed ring.

props.name: chipColor
props.description: Chip background.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims it and ignores input.

props.name: onChange
props.description: On every value change — even mid-drag.

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Only when the drag has ended and the value actually changed.

props.name: autoPreview
props.description: Automatic drag preview without interaction.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class for the root element.

tips: Use `onCommit` for heavy work and `onChange` for live display — keep that separation. `onChange` is called on every drag frame.
The input reads both Persian and Latin digits. Persian keyboards send Persian digits and a raw `parseFloat` reads them as `NaN`; here both work the same.
If you set `min` and `max` to the same number, the range becomes zero and the rubber-band stretch turns off — the component doesn't break, it just loses its spring.
Label and unit are UI, not data — they are shown on the chip itself and announced in `aria-valuetext`. So keep them Persian.
The value is **displayed** with Persian digits, but `aria-valuenow` stays a Latin number — the same thing assistive technology reads.
